project_type: npm-workspaces monorepo: shared types package + Express/MongoDB API server + Vite/React 18/MUI v9 client
build_system: npm workspaces (root package.json workspaces ["shared","server","client"]). TypeScript project references: shared builds via `tsc -b` to shared/dist; server references ../shared; client builds via `tsc -b && vite build`. QUIRK: shared/dist does NOT exist yet and MUST be built before any tsc -b type-check or the client/Vite build — tsx erases type-only imports so the server dev runner and seed run without it, but builds and type-checks do not. Node v22.14.0, npm 10.9.2.
test_framework: None configured in any workspace. No test runner, no test files. Verification is build + runtime smoke (curl / running the app), not unit tests. Do NOT invent a test framework unless adding one is explicitly needed; the design marks test setup out of scope.
build_command: Root: `npm run build` (shared -> server -> client). Per workspace: `npm run build --workspace=shared`, `--workspace=server`, `--workspace=client`.
test_command: No test command exists. Verify via: build commands above; `npm run seed` (server); `node server/dist/index.js` + curl against :4000; `npm run dev:client` for the SPA.
verification_instructions: 1) `npm install` at root, then `npm run build --workspace=shared` — confirm shared/dist/index.d.ts exists. 2) `npm run build --workspace=server` — tsc -b exits 0. 3) `npm run seed` — collections reseeded, admin bootstrapped (Atlas must be reachable). 4) `node server/dist/index.js`; curl /api/health -> {status:ok}; curl /api/league -> full League JSON, 6 teams, 4 leaderboards, no _id; POST /api/teams without token -> 401; POST /api/auth/login with ADMIN_USERNAME + generated ADMIN_PASSWORD -> {token,user}; same POST with Bearer token -> 200/201. 5) `npm run build --workspace=client` — tsc -b && vite build exit 0, zero TS errors. 6) Root `npm run build` all green. ATLAS CONTINGENCY: if MongoDB connection is refused (IP allowlist/auth), it is a REQUIRED MANUAL USER STEP (Atlas Network Access -> add current IP or 0.0.0.0/0 for dev; confirm readWrite). Report DB-dependent checks as BLOCKED, never as passed-when-skipped; continue verifying everything that does not need the live DB (all builds/type-checks).
snapshot_or_generated_files: shared/dist/* (produced by `npm run build --workspace=shared`; required before type-checks/client build). server/dist/* (produced by server build). No checked-in generated snapshots. env.ts APPENDS DB_NAME, JWT_SECRET, ADMIN_USERNAME, ADMIN_PASSWORD to atlas-credentials.env at runtime if missing — that file is gitignored (*.env).
environment_constraints: atlas-credentials.env (repo root) already defines MONGODB_USERNAME, MONGODB_PASSWORD, MONGODB_URI (all DOUBLE-QUOTED; dotenv strips quotes so process.env.MONGODB_URI is the clean URI — pass to new MongoClient() verbatim, never interpolate credentials, never re-strip/re-quote). Missing and to be appended: DB_NAME=bowling_league, strong random JWT_SECRET, ADMIN_USERNAME=admin, strong random ADMIN_PASSWORD. NEVER print/log/echo/grep/commit secret VALUES — key names only. The Atlas password and generated admin password must never appear in any committed file (including server/README.md). The project is NOT a git repository (no .git) — any 'commit locally' instruction cannot run until a repo is initialized; do NOT run git init or commit without explicit instruction, just note it; no build/test verification depends on git.
contribution_requirements: Shared types in shared/src/index.ts are FROZEN — do not edit. Follow design.md exactly. The five MEDIUM + three NIT findings in design-review.md are REQUIREMENTS: (1) MONGODB_URI quoting handled by dotenv, use verbatim; (2) generic stripMongoId<T extends {_id?:ObjectId}>({_id,...rest}):Omit<T,'_id'>; (3) /reports is a child of the existing <Route element={<Layout/>}> layout route, not a literal <Layout> wrapper; (4) name exports LeagueProvider + useLeague and wire <AuthProvider><LeagueProvider><App/></LeagueProvider></AuthProvider> in main.tsx; (5) exact results validation accepting the seed shape (awaySeries:0, single-element awayGames, differing array lengths); NITs: full mongodb import in db.ts, relative getReportUrl, unconditional removal of bowling-league.auth on load.
key_patterns: MUI v9: never use Typography shorthand props (fontWeight/fontStyle) — use sx={{...}}; Grid uses size={{ xs, sm, md }}; bowling icon is AdjustIcon (no SportsBowling). react-router v6: layout ROUTE pattern <Route element={<Layout/>}> with <Outlet/>, route order irrelevant for matching. Pages currently import { league, getTeamById, getBowlerById } from '../data/league'; only data/league.ts imports '../types'. Server: ESM 'type':'module'; all @bowling/shared imports in server are `import type` so tsx runs without shared/dist; whitelist discipline on every write (never spread raw body; identity keys immutable on PUT); express.json({limit:'1mb'}) is the SOLE JSON parser; reports upload chain is [upload.single('file'), handler] multer-first; global error handler owns MulterError status mapping (LIMIT_FILE_SIZE->413, LIMIT_UNEXPECTED_FILE->400, else 400); toWeeklyReport explicit 8-field mapper (never stripMongoId for reports, it would leak gridFsFileId); leaderboards GET has NO .sort() (insertion order is display order).
